output.title: Vault issuer server-name option: usage not shown in environment
output.content: The change is a new optional Vault issuer config for the server name used when validating the Vault server's certificate. The environment summary shows only a cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate and the installed CRD certificates.cert-manager.io [v1]. No Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifest, and no issuers.cert-manager.io or clusterissuers.cert-manager.io CRD, is listed, and the crds dimension is absent. Missing: whether any Issuer or ClusterIssuer uses a Vault issuer, and whether it needs a server-name override for TLS validation. Because this is a feature addition, nothing changes unless the operator opts in.
